note: Data of scripts/branch_accounting.py (G2-11). `cutoff`: a register created on or after this date must carry `## Branches` (an earlier one with no such section reads as legacy: nothing reconciled); the integrator sets it to the release's publication day when the release is built (F-8), never to a later day (a later day switches the check off for a real story; tests read this value and hard-code no date). `kinds`: the closed list of the `kind` column of `## Branches` (FR-13). `attachment_readings`: the closed list of the `reading` column of `## Attachments` (FR-13; an unknown word is refused, never read as a default). `attachment_read_forms` (AR-1): how a file is OPENED, not whether it is downloaded (that is `attachment_policy` in jira-fields.json): the first `by_media` prefix a media type starts with gives the call (`limit_1` a picture, `pages` a PDF, `whole` a text file); an empty or null type, or one in `unlabelled_media`, is decided by the suffix of the name (`by_suffix`); a labelled type no row names has no form and the file is named, not opened; `link_suffixes`: the suffixes of a saved link that are listed as files. `picture_signatures`: the first bytes of the picture formats (`parts`: [offset, hex] pairs, every part must match); the read guard recognises a picture by these first bytes, and a picture is judged by `read.max_image_bytes`, not by `read.max_bytes`. `attachment_text_lines`: the lines of the START of a text file over `read.max_bytes` the role is given to read (`Read <path> limit <n>`, and the row says so); 0 = such a file is named as too large and not read (set when the size of the mockup of 15045 is measured, M5). `rung_kinds_accepted` (RN1-13): the `rung_basis` kinds a manual row may rest on - a kind in `rung_kinds` but not here (`not_measured`) is known and refused; `rung_reason_priorities`: a row of such a priority owes `rung_basis.reason`; `rung_kind_fixes`: the way out the refusal of a refused kind names, by accepted kind (a kind not in `rung_kinds_accepted` is not offered). `attachment_words`: how gate A and the report word the state of an attachment (FR-13; `opened`: the receipt keys that mean the scout opened it; `causes`: the plain words by key - `skipped_by_policy:<verdict>`, an attachment's `analysis_status`, a link's `status`, and the reasons of the listing `no_path`, `file_missing`, `no_read_form`, `pdf_without_suffix`, `too_large`; a key with no row reads `unknown`, never opened). The `*_shown` limits (`attachments_shown`: the names gate A lists, 15) and `units_page` bound what is SHOWN, never what is reconciled: no value changes the verdict, only the form of a refusal (spec section 5.3); the values are chosen without a measurement and need none.

rung_kind_fixes.measured: probe the API/component rung and write `{"kind": "measured", "ref": "<what was called and what came back>"}`
rung_kind_fixes.impossible: name why the environment cannot run it: `{"kind": "impossible", "ref": "<the environment's reason>"}`

causes.skipped_by_policy:never: this kind of file is not downloaded
causes.skipped_by_policy:type: this file type is not downloaded
causes.partial: only part of it could be read
causes.no_path: the receipt has no usable path to the file
causes.no_read_form: this file type cannot be opened here
causes.pdf_without_suffix: saved before this build could open a PDF
causes.too_large: too large to read at this stage
